# Due to the nature of instagram being picture picture/video first, unlike facebook, x, or threads which people can share their thoughts as a written post, it's difficult to yield relevant informations on instagram.
# rows with 'replysource' being not null is an indication that the row is a reply/comment of a source post, thus at a glance their data seem to don't correlate much but they actually does,
# though the weakness is sometimes the comments are outlier, like promotions.
